title: Fix 'reading toString' error on country selection

requirements.text: Fix the 'Cannot read property toString' error that occurs when a country is selected in the country selection flow

quotes: (reading 'toString' )error showing up once country is selected

acceptanceCriteria: Country selection completes without throwing toString errors
All country selection flows (EU VAT intro, UK, country transaction steps) handle undefined/null values safely
Error does not reoccur after country is selected

requirements.text: Add null safety checks to all country selection onChange handlers to prevent undefined crashes when accessing country properties
acceptanceCriteria: All country code references are guarded with optional chaining or explicit null checks
Country object property access (like .toString()) includes null/undefined validation
No console errors appear during country selection interactions

constraints: Preserve existing country selection UI and user experience
Maintain compatibility with existing VAT calculation flows
nonGoals: Adding new countries or VAT rates
